name: Son Vell (Vestige Collection)
description: An 18th-century manor house southwest of Ciutadella, restored by Vestige Collection on a 180-hectare estate that walks down to its own cove. Rooms and suites are spread between the main house, converted outbuildings and new garden pavilions; two outdoor pools, two restaurants (Vermell and Sa Clarisa) under chef Joan Bagur, and the Camí de Cavalls passing the gate. The flagship of quiet luxury on the island.

practicalInfo.acceso: Son Vell estate, Sant Joan de Missa road, Ciutadella (about 20 minutes from town).
practicalInfo.horario: Seasonal opening: check 2026 dates on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: Garden suites, two outdoor pools, two restaurants and a bar, semi-private cove on foot, estate experiences.
